affected_subject.reason: Identifies _checkMintCap in LatentSwapLogic.sol as the affected function.

trigger_or_action.reason: Mint operation in small markets where marketBaseTokenSupply <= (1 << noCapLimit) triggers the flawed check.

direct_effect.reason: Mint cap disabled, allowing users to mint tokens far in excess of intended limits.

safety_relation_basis.reason: Expected cap (mint not larger than supply or Q96) vs actual uncapped minting due to && instead of ||.

summary: Report identifies the flawed _checkMintCap function, the small-market mint trigger, the cap-bypass effect, and the intended-vs-actual cap relation, sufficient to attempt formalization.
